source_snapshot.procedure: 【Before Test】 verify configuration and clear logs. 【During Test】 issue raw 0x06 0x36 in-band and also an OOB lanplus example. 【After Test】 collect evidence and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds; copied reset-health checks require BMC alive after reset, unchanged MAC/IP, non-default SEL time and unchanged power.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Claims no runnable stock command despite the source providing raw 0x06 0x36; requests exact expected output.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL recognizes missing expected output but understates that the source already supplies the raw request.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / CHANGED; validates completion, length and BT capability fields while separating copied reset criteria.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 1009/2291 leaves the case PARTIAL with operator variables and notes the command/acceptance mismatch.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The OOB BT-capability variant confirms transport-specific coverage; neither transport may use Warm Reset as a substitute.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats parser/reference inputs as readiness rather than permanent blocking; ED-35 preserves read-only coverage; ED-38 forbids retries and credential leakage.

original_test_intent: Read and decode the BMC BT interface capability response through the intended in-band path and verify the returned interface properties.
original_method: Run the preserved raw 0x06 0x36 request in-band; retain the source's OOB example only as optional correlation, then validate the capability response rather than executing reset-related actions.
manual_activity: Engineer approves the firmware-specific response schema and capability reference; no per-run confirmation is needed for the bounded read after those inputs are present.
required_inputs: Expected BT capability values or ranges
safety_requirements: Do not issue BMC reset, power or configuration commands.
Never place OOB credentials on a visible command line.
Fail closed on nonzero completion, malformed length or unknown fields.
agent_execution_scope: Issue one bounded in-band raw 0x06 0x36 read.
Validate completion, exact length, field values and reserved bits against the approved schema.
Optionally correlate protected OOB output without treating it as IB replacement.
Return evidence without setting DUT PASS.
engineer_actions: Approve response schema and Project capability reference.
Resolve the copied reset criteria in the Review acceptance layer while preserving Master.
Own final verdict on capability mismatches.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative: the source identifies the request bytes, but DeepSeek is right that response semantics are needed before verdict automation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved secret-safe in-band wrapper for raw 0x06 0x36 with bounded timeout and a versioned five-field parser; OOB only as optional correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source raw bytes, transport examples, Script reference and 10/5-minute values remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the raw response once, verify completion and exact response framing, decode outstanding requests, input/output buffer sizes, request-to-response timing and retry recommendation per the approved firmware schema, and compare to Project expectations.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMCs implementing the documented BT capability command on the approved in-band path.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-approved vendor/IPMI command schema and platform capability specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Keeps raw 0x06/0x36 but removes unsafe log clearing/credential exposure and replaces irrelevant reset checks with capability-field acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB remains mandatory; optional OOB correlation does not claim OOB-only coverage as IB PASS.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Target, parser schema and capability reference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect parser can misreport queue sizes/timing and misconfigure later management traffic.

project_override_considerations: Another approved read tool is acceptable only if it exposes equivalent raw completion and all capability fields; a high-level success label alone is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact redacted request and raw response
Completion code, length and decoded BT capability fields
Optional same-target OOB correlation and proof no mutation occurred

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source title/command are a read-only BT capability query, but most Criteria describe a BMC reset that the Procedure never performs; those checks cannot establish BT capability correctness.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command and read intent are defined. Missing schema/reference are execution-readiness inputs, and the Review layer can correct acceptance without changing Master.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Upgrades PARTIAL to fully automatable once parser/reference inputs are supplied.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on bounded 0x06/0x36 parsing and rejects reset criteria as the primary verdict.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Resolves the prior PARTIAL gate through explicit schema and evidence requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Preserves IB coverage separate from the OOB variant.

review_improvement: Turns command-success-only evidence into field-level BT capability validation and prevents unrelated reset checks from creating a false PASS.
independent_technical_reasoning: The request bytes are explicitly present and read-only, so tool execution can be automated without human confirmation. Correctness depends on response framing and capability-field decoding, not on BMC reset health. The contradictory Criteria are a source conflict, but not a permanent execution block.
